title: Bounded native rainfall plus active fixed-water-table FMC composition comparator
purpose: Test whether the already-qualified FMC native rainfall/ponding/runoff route and the already-qualified G25 fixed-water-table groundwater-front route remain jointly mass-conservative and hydrologically competitive with R2 when active simultaneously, without introducing contact/merge, hiatus detachment, ET/root uptake, or new groundwater architecture.

predecessor_authority.D13: FMC fixed-water-table groundwater-front branch retained research candidacy versus R2.
predecessor_authority.D17: Separated surface-connected plus G25 groundwater-front composition retained candidacy under prescribed infiltration, with no contact/merge.
predecessor_authority.D19: Exact constructed contact/merge can retain candidacy, but D24 intentionally stays in the separated branch.
predecessor_authority.D20: One-hour fixed-water-table repeated-forcing persistence retained candidacy.
predecessor_authority.D21: Native R16/FMC rainfall threshold labels are non-equivalent and may not be retuned to match.
predecessor_authority.D22: FMC native one-step surface-threshold response is competitive with R2.
predecessor_authority.D23: Short native rainfall/ponding/runoff/redistribution trajectory beats R2 on every preregistered surface/redistribution frontier view under zero bottom flux.
predecessor_authority.implication: D24 composes already admitted surface and groundwater branches only. It does not alter their equations, thresholds, bins, process step, or numerical authority.

retained: simultaneous land-surface infiltration fronts and groundwater fronts in the finite-water-content domain
surface water first satisfies K(theta_i)*dt throughflow demand associated with bins connected to groundwater
surface infiltration fronts use the admitted Eq.18 kinematics
groundwater fronts use the admitted Eq.21 kinematics
surface-groundwater contact/merge exists in the method but remains outside the separated D24 envelope

surface_component.connected_fronts: linear in j from z_101=120 cm to z_199=10 cm

groundwater_component.groundwater_front_height: H_j=0.25*abs(psi(theta_j)) above the fixed water table

initial_composite_state.occupancy: baseline theta_i over full column plus disjoint surface-connected [0,z_j] and groundwater-connected [160-H_j,160] increments for each active bin
initial_composite_state.required_separation: z_j + H_j < 160 cm at initialization and after every D24 process step
initial_composite_state.R16_R2_mapping: exact finite-volume cell-average mapping followed by inverse B01 retention

histories.interpretation: low native-rain control with active groundwater front
known D21/D23 native threshold-mismatch forcing with active groundwater front
active-runoff forcing with active groundwater front

R16_R2_route.top_boundary: current-canonical dynamic-top provider resolved each 10 s interval from committed top-cell state and previous accepted surface store; native threshold labels are not forced to match FMC
R16_R2_route.bottom_boundary: mode 5, fixed zero pressure head at 160 cm
R16_R2_route.numerical_authority: D4 strict-first integrated-water-depth research reattempt policy with hard accepted transaction mass gate 1e-12 cm
R16_R2_route.surface_store_ownership: research comparator state external to fixed-flux Reference kernel; provider actual_top_flux is materialized as the accepted explicit top flux for one soil-water interval

FMC_route.state: D17 separated surface-connected fronts + G25 groundwater fronts + D22 external surface store/runoff state
per_step: available surface water = previous accepted surface store + rainfall depth
reserve gray-bin throughflow K(theta_i)*dt from available surface water; require available supply >= this frozen demand
count gray-bin demand as direct downward bottom exchange through the surface-groundwater-connected baseline pathway
allocate all remaining available surface water to existing connected fronts according to D14/D16 Eq.18 potential demand and D15 left-to-right finite-volume accounting
route any residual surface water through the frozen D22 linear ponding/runoff reservoir law
advance D13 G25 groundwater fronts by Eq.21 forward Euler for the same 10 s step and apply conservative groundwater-front relaxation
groundwater-front storage change contributes bottom exchange exactly as in D13/D17
total bottom-outward exchange = gray-bin direct throughflow - groundwater-front storage change
require every surface and groundwater occupied interval to remain strictly separated; any contact closes D24 fail-closed
global ledger includes soil storage, previous/new surface store, rainfall, runoff, and bottom exchange
FMC_route.infiltration_depth_definition: gray-bin throughflow + connected-front finite-volume allocation; this is the atmospheric water depth that enters the soil column during the interval
FMC_route.terminal_bottom_flux: D17 terminal_bottom_flux from the G25 groundwater-front state after the step

checks: exact initial composite storage and 16-cell mapping
available surface water >= frozen gray-bin K(theta_i)*dt demand at every step
all connected-front and groundwater-front states remain finite and physical
surface and groundwater intervals remain strictly separated for all 16 steps
no dry-bin activation, falling slug, contact, merge, clipping, or fallback
surface reservoir ledger closes to <=1e-12 cm every step
FMC global soil+surface+runoff+bottom-exchange ledger closes to <=1e-12 cm every step
internal_preflight_before_Richards_traje.failure_rule: Any failure closes D24 before generating R16/R2 trajectories. Do not retune rainfall factors, duration, lambda, initial state, ponding/runoff law, bins, process step, Eq.18, Eq.21, gray-bin demand, relaxation or decision gates.

outputs_per_interval: bottom-outward exchange and cumulative bottom exchange
R16/R2 nonlinear work and research reattempt count

comparison_metrics.R2_profile_mapping: repeat each 80-cm R2 cell-average theta over its corresponding eight R16 cells

all_required: FMC-only preflight passes before any R16/R2 trajectory generation
all RG05/RG20/RG40 R16, R2 and FMC histories complete with integrity

interpretation_boundary.if_positive: Retain FMC as a bounded concurrent native-rainfall + fixed-water-table hydraulic research candidate relative to R2. This may justify same-runtime performance screening, but not formal performance or production admission.
interpretation_boundary.if_negative: Do not retune D12-D23 physics or threshold semantics. Diagnose whether the failing view is surface, profile, balance, or groundwater flux and restrict FMC candidacy accordingly.
interpretation_boundary.neither_outcome: No ET/root uptake, seasonal water balance, arbitrary water-table depth, live MODFLOW coupling, application acceptance, formal speedup or production ROM authority.
